description: This file contains utility functions and types for setting and tracking modifications of YAML nodes within the kustomize project, specifically for handling setters and mutation tracking.

classes.name: TrackableSetter
classes.description: A struct that wraps setter functions with optional mutation tracking via callback.

methods.name: SetScalar
methods.description: Returns a SetFn to set a scalar value.

methods.name: SetEntry
methods.description: Returns a SetFn to set a field or map entry to a value.

methods.name: WithMutationTracker
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked each time a field is mutated.

methods.name: SetScalar
methods.description: Method on TrackableSetter to set a scalar value, invoking callback if registered.

methods.name: SetScalarIfEmpty
methods.description: Sets a scalar value only if it isn't already set, invoking callback if registered.

methods.name: SetEntry
methods.description: Method on TrackableSetter to set a field or map entry, invoking callback if registered.

methods.name: SetEntryIfEmpty
methods.description: Sets a field or map entry only if it isn't already set, invoking callback if registered.
